integrity: The quaternary ideal is reconstructed directly from the published descending coefficient string. Exact finite enumeration checks the reported type and Lee distance, the full Gray image, binary linearity, cyclic generator, complete weight distribution, and dual distance.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the single displayed record-breaking \(\mathbb Z_4\) negacyclic \([36,2,8,16]\) code. It does not assert linear Gray images for the other source codes or binary-distance optimality of the resulting \([72,12,16]\) code.
title: The record-breaking \(\mathbb Z_4\) negacyclic \([36,2,8,16]\) code has a linear cyclic Gray image
